notes.title: Unwanted visitors Demo released!
notes.content:
We have just released Demo version of Unwanted visitors. While we continue working on the game we would like to ask you for your feedback (through the form in game or in steam discussions).

Limitations of the demo:
- 1 map only
- 1 character type only
- no multiplayer
- limited set of enemy types

The leaderboard is also available in Demo version, so you can compete with other players.
